name: EnabledDisableToggle
description: Switch with confirmation that enables or disables a container, miner, or feature flag

props.name: value
props.description: Current state. A boolean drives a switch display; non-boolean shows action buttons

props.name: tankNumber
props.description: Tank identifier used in the label (`Tank {N} Circulation`). Pass an empty string for the air exhaust label

props.name: isButtonDisabled
props.description: Disables the Enable/Disable buttons when a command is in-flight

props.name: isOffline
props.description: Disables all controls and shows an offline tooltip

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Callback fired when the user confirms a state change
